spec.definitions:
def horner : List ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
  | [], _ => 0
  | a :: rest, x => a + x * horner rest x

def exactCheck (gate : Bool) (coeffs : List ℚ) (x b : ℚ) : Bool :=
  gate && decide (|horner coeffs x| ≤ b)
spec.conclusion: ∀ (gate : Bool) (coeffs : List ℚ) (x b : ℚ), exactCheck gate coeffs x b = true ↔ gate = true ∧ |horner coeffs x| ≤ b
spec.proof:
by
  intro gate coeffs x b
  simp [exactCheck]
